name: radio
title: Radio
description: A radio group component with animated SVG indicator and primary/neutral variants. Uses namespace exports: Radio.Group, Radio.Item.

docs.lead: A radio group component with animated SVG indicator and primary/neutral color variants.
docs.usage:
import * as Radio from "@/components/ui/radio"

<Radio.Group defaultValue="r1">
  <Radio.Item value="r1" />
  <Radio.Item value="r2" />
</Radio.Group>

examples.title: Variants
examples.code:
<Radio.Group variant="primary" defaultValue="r1">
  <Radio.Item value="r1" />
</Radio.Group>
<Radio.Group variant="neutral" defaultValue="r1">
  <Radio.Item value="r1" />
</Radio.Group>
